anita: Quick heads-up — finished a short bring-up of llama2-phi-13b-int8 (quant) across H100/A100 in us-east / us-west / eu-west. I toggled edge routing: direct-region vs proxy-edge vs fallback-mux. Main finding: p50 is stable but p95 gets pulled up ~15-25% for some paths. raw numbers below, pls skim.

bench-bot: run summary (ms / rps) — timestamped run: 2026-03-19T14:02Z
region,gpu,route,p50_ms,p95_ms,tail_max_ms,throughput_rps
us-east,H100,direct,68,122,210,220
us-east,H100,proxy-edge,70,140,260,210
us-west,H100,direct,72,130,230,205
us-west,H100,proxy-edge,80,155,320,185
eu-west,A100,direct,85,170,360,160
eu-west,A100,proxy-edge,95,205,420,140

matt_g: Nice, thanks. A couple quick notes: 1) the proxy-edge cases correlate with higher hop counts (adds ~1 RTT ≈ 8–12ms per hop) and also more frequent KV cache misses in our trace. 2) batching knob was set to max 8; lower batches bring p95 down but cut throughput.

anita: Yep — I kept batch_max=8 for parity. I also ran a small warmup test (1000 short prompts) vs cold start; warmup reduced p95 by ~18% on proxy-edge.

oliver: Kernel note: H100 saw a bigger delta when using the newer fused-attn kernel vs fallback. On proxy-edge the kernel scheduling ended up on fallback paths more often (maybe due to seq len distribution shift). Suggest forcing fused-attn for a canary to check.

sudha: From capacity planning POV — if proxy-edge is default for a customer region, plan for ~20% extra headroom to keep p95 SLO. Also this means reserved slots on H100 should be sized for throughput_rps * 1.2.

kim: Can you paste the exact routing policy and the k6 command you used? I want to reproduce locally.

anita: sure — k6 command:
```
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 2m --tag region=us-west ./scripts/llama_infer_k6.js
```
routing policy snippet I used (canary):
```json
{"route_policy": "edge_pref", "fallback": ["region_direct","mux_fallback"], "max_hops": 3}
```

deploy-bot: note: canary flag edge_pref is on in staging for eng-ml; toggle path: /flags/edge_pref -> true/false (audited).

matt_g: Small experiment idea: run with batch_max=4 + force_fused=true on H100 proxy-edge and compare p95. If improves without big tput loss that's a win.

oliver: agree. I can spin canary on H100 in us-west and pin kernel. Expect p95 to drop ~10–15% from forcing fused.

anita: action items: @oliver -> run pinned-kernel canary on us-west H100 with batch_max 4 (start tomorrow morning). @kim -> reproduce with same k6 script and record KV cache hit rates + hop count. @sudha -> update capacity calc to include 20% buffer for proxy-edge traffic.

sudha: noted. I'll update the sizing doc and push numbers to the capacity dashboard.

kim: reproducing now, will report back in this thread with plots. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

bench-bot: attaching live logs link: https://bench.redwood.example/runs/2167890123 (kv_hit_rate & hop histograms available)

anita: thanks all. tagging this as follow-up for next eng-ml sync. :rocket:
